newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to stay out of banking system Friday.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to stay out of banking system Friday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to stay out of the banking system Friday morning as its add need was seen met until at least Monday, economists said.

"With a 10-day system and five-day system repurchase agreement on the books, the Fed will likely refrain from intervening in the money markets today," said Kathy Bostjancic, money market analyst at UBS Securities.
"There will be no Fed today, the outstanding are sufficient to meet the needs until after the weekend," concurred Jerry Zukowski, economist at PaineWebber Inc.
The federal funds rate was opened at 5-3/16 percent, near the Fed's current official target level of 5.25 percent.
-- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663
